messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

messages.name: get_my_order
messages.content: {"ok": false, "refused": "actor_owns", "explanation": "Not found among this customer's orders and requests."}

messages.text:
I can only help with orders belonging to your signed-in account, and that order wasn’t found among yours (refund-policy/v2/scope).

A refund also cannot be sent to another person’s card; it can only go to the order’s original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment). Hugo will need to contact us from his own account.
